display.purpose: Page title, with ‘for You’ set in rose italic.

headline.purpose: A short, balanced note inside the sealed cover.

title.purpose: The name in the postcard footer.

body.purpose: The short note beneath the page title.

label.purpose: Dates, drag hints, and the reduced-motion note.

action.purpose: Save postcard, Grow another, and Replay bloom.

action-reset.purpose: Reset view beside the drag hint.

action-primary.purpose: Open your flowers and Send flowers.

shadows.name: postcard-lift
shadows.purpose: One soft outer lift separates the postcard from the page.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Easing for the cover lift, button press, and action icon opacity transitions.

motion.name: cover-lift
motion.purpose: The cover fades and lifts by 2% on pointer activation; keyboard or assistive activation and reduced motion dismiss it immediately.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Buttons scale to .97 on press, with no transform in reduced motion.

motion.name: action-icon-fade
motion.purpose: Share and save swap their icons in place, with a check on success. Icon changes are instant with reduced motion.

motion.name: pending-spinner
motion.purpose: One turn per cycle, only while share or save is pending. The pending icon is still with reduced motion.

motion.name: bloom
motion.purpose: Opening and Grow another show full bloom immediately for keyboard or assistive activation, or with reduced motion. Replay bloom plays with any input method when motion is allowed; reduced motion omits Replay and shows a note when the bouquet is ready.

motion.name: turn-momentum
motion.purpose: Drag tracks input directly. On release the spring carries the flick to its projected rest; grabbing interrupts it. Reduced motion skips the spring, not the drag.

motion.name: turn-reset
motion.purpose: Pointer Reset view takes the shortest path to the front. Keyboard turns and resets are instant, as is pointer reset with reduced motion. No idle motion once settled.

components.name: Open your flowers
components.description: The filled rose action on the sealed cover, with an ink focus outline.
components.css: .ds-open { min-height: 46px; padding: .5rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--rose, #9a4d5c); color: var(--paper, #fff9f2); font: 600 .9375rem/1.25 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation; transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.23, 1, .32, 1)); } .ds-open:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #573b3d); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-open:disabled { opacity: .55; } .ds-open:not(:disabled):active { background: var(--rose-hover, #803d4b); transform: scale(.97); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-open:not(:disabled):hover { background: var(--rose-hover, #803d4b); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-open { transition: none; } .ds-open:not(:disabled):active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Send flowers
components.description: The primary action after opening; its label stays in place as the icon indicates pending or success.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-send"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 2v13m4-9-4-4-4 4M4 12v8a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-8"/></svg>Send flowers</button>

components.name: Save postcard
components.description: The outlined footer action. Its icon indicates pending or success without changing the label, which shortens visually on small screens.

components.css: .ds-cover { position: relative; display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: .82rem; min-height: 16rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 14px; text-align: center; background: var(--paper, #fff9f2); color: var(--ink, #573b3d); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px #573b3d0a, 0 14px 36px -16px #573b3d45; } .ds-cover::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e7d3ce); border-radius: 9px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-seal { display: block; width: clamp(5rem, 17vw, 6.5rem); color: var(--rose, #9a4d5c); } .ds-cover-note { margin: 0 0 .35rem; font: 400 clamp(1.9rem, 1.55rem + 1.7vw, 2.7rem)/1 var(--serif, 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: -.02em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-cover-open { min-height: 46px; padding: .5rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--rose, #9a4d5c); color: var(--paper, #fff9f2); font: 600 .9375rem/1.25 'DM Sans', sans-serif; touch-action: manipulation; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.23, 1, .32, 1)); } .ds-cover-open:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #573b3d); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-cover-open:not(:disabled):active { background: var(--rose-hover, #803d4b); transform: scale(.97); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-cover-open:not(:disabled):hover { background: var(--rose-hover, #803d4b); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cover-open { transition: none; } .ds-cover-open:not(:disabled):active { transform: none; } } .ds-cover-loading { min-height: 1lh; margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #765b5d); font: 400 .8125rem/1.5 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: like something you'd send to your partner
narrative.overview:
The postcard feels like personal stationery rather than a botanical specimen sheet. A blush page frames a single cream card, and the envelope mark and short note make the closed card feel addressed to someone.

Before opening, leave space around the invitation. After opening, the hand-tied bouquet supplies the color and detail; the stationery and controls stay quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Blush surroundings, cream paper, and rose accents.
Expressive serif lettering and plain sans-serif controls.
A deliberate opening and a bloom that settles to stillness.

rules.name: The Rose Accent Rule
rules.body: Use rose on the invitation, the primary action, and focus, not as a tint over the whole card or the bouquet.

rules.name: The Paper Depth Rule
rules.body: Give the postcard one outer lift; use hairlines for the inset and internal separation, not an outer border plus shadow.

dos: Do let the bouquet carry the strongest colors and most of the detail.
Do keep the opening explicit and make the finished bouquet available immediately for keyboard activation or reduced motion.
Do keep an obvious focus outline, including when focus moves from the cover to the bouquet.
donts: Don't bring back visible specimen numbers or registration marks on the postcard.
Don't animate the bouquet at rest or make turning it a prerequisite for enjoying it.
